business_summary: Chong Fai Jewellery Group Holdings Company Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the retail and wholesale of jewelry products in Hong Kong. It engages in the wholesale of its jewelry products to other jewelry retailers; and trading of recycled gold products, as well as provision of gem-set and pure gold jewellery. The company sells its products through a network of retail stores under the Chong Fai Jewellery brand name. The company was formerly known as Dominate Group Holdings Company Limited and changed its name to Chong Fai Jewellery Group Holdings Company Limited in March 2020. Chong Fai Jewellery Group Holdings Company Limited was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Hung Hom, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Chong Fai Jewellery Group Holdings Company Limited는 홍콩에서 보석 제품의 소매 및 도매에 종사하고 있습니다. 다른 보석 소매업체에 보석 제품을 도매하는 사업에 종사하고 있습니다. 재활용 금 제품 거래, 보석 세팅 및 순금 장신구 제공. 회사는 Chong Fai Jewellery 브랜드 이름으로 소매점 네트워크를 통해 제품을 판매합니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Dominate Group Holdings Company Limited로 알려졌으며 2020년 3월에 Chong Fai Jewellery Group Holdings Company Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. Chong Fai Jewellery Group Holdings Company Limited는 1997년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 훙홈에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
